name: All Might
summary: My Hero Academia's Symbol of Peace: Toshinori Yagi, the world's greatest hero and eighth holder of One For All, who passes the power to the Quirkless boy Izuku Midoriya.
origin: Toshinori Yagi was born without a Quirk, just like Izuku would be. He became the eighth holder of One For All, a power handed down from one person to the next, and rose to become the world's top hero and its ever-smiling Symbol of Peace. His smile came from his mentor Nana Shimura, who taught him that people who smile are the strongest. A crippling injury from his first fight with the villain All For One finally leads him to pick Izuku as his successor. He joins U.A. High as a teacher, where he's enthusiastic but inexperienced and needs a script for his first lesson.
powers: One For All: immense strength, speed and durability
Can pass One For All to a chosen successor
Veteran combatant with decades of hero work
Inspiring presence as the Symbol of Peace

storyline.title: Meeting Izuku
storyline.beat: The world's greatest hero crosses paths with a Quirkless boy who still dreams of being a hero.

storyline.title: Passing the torch
storyline.beat: Impressed by Izuku's courage, All Might chooses him to inherit One For All.

storyline.title: U.A. faculty
storyline.beat: He teaches at U.A. High, earnest but clumsy in the classroom, and surprisingly ruthless as an exam opponent.

storyline.title: All For One
storyline.beat: He beats All For One again, but the fight uses up the last of his One For All for good.

storyline.title: Raising the next hero
storyline.beat: Retired from hero work, he puts everything into training Izuku to become the next Symbol of Peace.

gossip.text: Horikoshi has called All Might a callback to classic Superman.
Horikoshi said front-on drawings of All Might were exhausting because of all the heavy shading.
All Might was born with his superpower.
gossip.truth: He was born Quirkless. His power is One For All, passed down to him by his predecessor.

gossip.text: His old wound cost him his stomach and part of his respiratory system, which is why he keeps coughing up blood.
He's voiced by Kenta Miyake in Japanese and Christopher Sabat in English.
He addresses his students as 'Young' plus their surname, such as Young Midoriya.

quiz.q: What is All Might's real name?
What is the name of the power All Might passes to Izuku?
quiz.why: One For All is handed from holder to holder. All For One belongs to his archenemy.

quiz.q: Which classic hero was the main model for All Might?
quiz.why: Horikoshi has described All Might as a callback to classic Superman.

theme.tagline: Smiles first, punches second, never leaves anyone behind.

timeline.title: My Hero Academia begins
timeline.note: All Might appears in chapter 1 when the series starts in Weekly Shōnen Jump in July 2014.

timeline.title: Bones’ anime
timeline.note: The TV anime premieres in April 2016, with Kenta Miyake voicing All Might in Japanese.

timeline.title: The last of One For All
timeline.note: His final clash with All For One at Kamino uses up his power for good and ends his hero career.

timeline.title: Two Heroes
timeline.note: The first feature film sends All Might and Izuku to a floating research island for a rare team-up.

timeline.title: Armored All Might
timeline.note: Quirkless but stubborn, he suits up in a mechanical suit to stall All For One in the final war.

timeline.title: The manga ends
timeline.note: My Hero Academia closes in August 2024 after ten years of weekly chapters.

timeline.title: The final season
timeline.note: The eighth and last anime season airs from October to December 2025.
